source_documents.title: Reversible Thermochromism of Aggregation-Induced Emission-Active Benzophenone Azine Based on Polymorph-Dependent Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer Fluorescence

reference_evidence_units.quote: 10 μmol L−1 1 displayed nearly no fluorescence in the low water fraction range from 0 to 60%
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Water/EtOH, 10 micromolar, 10 mM HEPES pH 7.0; excitation 390 nm.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Nearly absent emission below 60% water; 542 nm band grows at 70-90%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Intensity and absorption tail indicate aggregation but not a unique microscopic pathway.

reference_evidence_units.quote: free rotations around N−N and C−C single bonds
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose rotations as nonradiative pathways, inhibited by aggregate packing to allow ESIPT fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No direct torsional dynamics or viscosity test in selected evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a Stokes shift as large as 152 nm was observed for 1 as a result of ESIPT.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors assign the large Stokes shift to ESIPT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Does not directly time-resolve proton transfer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 1-Crys.(G) (quantum yield 17% and lifetime 1.24 ns) and 1-Crys.(YG) (quantum yield 13% and lifetime 1.15 ns)
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 crystal polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Ethyl acetate slow evaporation; integrating sphere QY, 372 nm lifetime excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: G and YG have QY/lifetime 17%/1.24 ns and 13%/1.15 ns; peaks 521 and 540 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal measurements, not aqueous aggregate QY; no separate rate mechanism inferred.

reference_evidence_units.quote: intramolecular hydrogen bonds from the salicylaldimine, which provided a structural basis for ESIPT process, were observed for both of the two polymorphs.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.statement: H bonds are invoked as structural basis for ESIPT.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Ground-state structures do not demonstrate excited-state proton motion.

reference_evidence_units.quote: molecules in polymorph 1-Crys.(YG) packed in a much tighter mode, resulting in the fluorescence in a relative longer wavelength range.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.statement: Tighter YG packing is proposed to explain redder emission; interplane spacing is smaller.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Fig. 4/Table 1 visually inspected. Prose says larger YG angles, but table angles are smaller; inconsistency not silently corrected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: they both existed as crystallines rather than amorphous powders
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 powders
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXRD after synthesis or THF evaporation, Fig. 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Both powder states are crystalline, matching their crystal polymorphs.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not merely an amorphous/crystalline transition; no raw refinement inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: upon repeated thermal cycles, the emission peak of 1 shifted between 522 and 541 nm as expected.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compound 1 thermal switching
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 231 C annealing; 236 C melting followed by cooling; Fig. 8.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Repeated thermal treatment switches emission between 522 and 541 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Detailed thermal-treatment PXRD and stability plots in SI were not inspected.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve explicitly proposed rotation restriction without treating it as uniquely proven.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Polymorph packing interconversion is central to reversible thermochromism.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Explicit ESIPT assignment supported by Stokes shift and H bonds, not direct time-resolved proton transfer.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state assignment is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Explicit ESIPT assignment supported by Stokes shift and H bonds, not direct time-resolved proton transfer.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
